facts.value: The bioinformatics approach served as the main tool for the analytical examination of experiment data that led to the study of how genetic variation, gene expression, and disease genes work.
Functional structural bioinformatics, the field surrounded by methods for calculating protein structures and reproducing molecular interactions, was improved.

New fields of bioinformatics such as systems biology and computational genomics emerged, focusing on understanding biological systems as a whole unit through integrating computer- and experimental-based approaches.
